title: Export-tab "Result detail" is point-specific but only reset on jobId change, so it goes stale (and keeps Save/Log disabled) after selecting a different frontier point
description: handleLoadResultDetail issues applyOptimiser with `point_index: selectedIdx` (L327), making the loaded ApplyOptimiserResponse specific to the currently selected frontier point. ResultDetailStatus then renders that point's row counts ("{returnedRows} of {totalRows} rows loaded", L810-822). But resultDetail is reset to idle ONLY when jobId changes (effect at L185-188 with deps [abortResultDetailRequest, jobId]); there is no reset when selectedIdx changes. So: load detail for point A (status becomes 'loaded'), then click point B (same job, so no reset) -> the Export tab still shows point A's row counts, attributed to the now-selected point B. Compounding this, terminalDetailBlocksActions = resultDetail.status === 'loading' || 'loaded' (L169) is passed as terminalActionsDisabled to both ExportTab (L465) and the Frontier DetailCard (L427); since 'loaded' is a persistent state never cleared on selection change, the Save Result and Log to MLflow buttons stay disabled across point selections (and effectively until the next jobId / 'Refresh detail') even though the user is now looking at a different, un-previewed point.
evidence: L327 payload: ...(selectedIdx != null && frontier ? { point_index: selectedIdx } : {}) -> detail is per-point. Reset effect L185: useEffect(() => { abortResultDetailRequest(); setResultDetail({status:'idle'}) }, [abortResultDetailRequest, jobId]) — jobId only, not selectedIdx. ResultDetailStatus L810-812 reads detail.data.preview_row_count/row_count of the OLD point. L169 terminalDetailBlocksActions includes status==='loaded'; wired to DetailCard.terminalActionsDisabled (L427) and ExportTab (L465) which disable Save/Log (DetailCard L113/L185/L199, ExportTab L719/L741). grep confirms setResultDetail only fires at L187 (jobId), L322, L332, L336 — nothing on selectedIdx. No test pins this.
